title: 第九十二章权色迷局第九十一章江湖路远

权色迷局（权色迷局（，编织私通外敌的罪名。
萧琰垂眸看着杯中摇曳的酒液，眼底清冷无波。
他清楚，这杯酒，看似温柔祝福，实则暗藏剧毒。
不仅是酒中可能暗藏的迷药，更是人心算计、朝堂构陷的无形剧毒。
他抬手，并未接酒，反而淡淡抬手虚扶，语气平和却不容置喙：“郡主远来是客，当为本将敬你。
只是边关武将，素来酒浅，不胜酒力，还望郡主海涵。”
话音落，他侧身避开，顺势端过案上清茶，浅酌一口，以茶代酒，从容回敬。
彻底避开所有温柔陷阱，不给对方半分构陷的契机。
明华郡主手中的酒杯微微一顿，脸上的温柔笑意几近维持不住。
她行走各方，周旋权贵，从未有男子能在她的美色攻势下如此无动于衷、步步设防。
眼前的萧琰，冷静得可怕，克制得惊人。
“将军果真自律克己。”
明华郡主缓缓收回手，轻声感慨，语气中带着一丝不易察觉的挫败，“这般心性，难怪能镇守西疆三年，稳如磐石。”
萧琰未再多言，目光掠过庭院灯火，望向城外沉沉夜色。
凉州城的雾，越来越浓了。
这座看似繁华安稳的边城，早已被权欲与色欲浸透，人人身在局中，无人能够独善其身。
温柔是刀，美色是网，权谋是局，层层缠绕，密不透风。
宴席直至深夜方才散去。
萧琰辞别众人，转身离去，背影挺拔孤冷，踏碎满院灯火繁花，不留半分眷恋。

待他走远，庭院之中的温情氛围瞬间消散。
顾延之面色沉冷，立于廊下，望着萧琰离去的方向，沉声开口：“油盐不进，软硬不吃，这萧琰，比三年前难对付百倍。”
明华郡主缓步走来，褪去了方才的温柔媚态，眼底只剩冷冽算计：“废太子蛰伏三年，心府早已今非昔比。
他看似安分守己，实则暗中掌控凉州兵权、收拢民心，根基日渐稳固。
若不能早日将他困住、除掉，日后必成大患。”
一旁的苏清鸢静静伫立，月色落在她清雅的侧脸，明暗交错，神色难辨。
她轻声开口，声音清淡却精准：“他不是不近美色，是不近无用的美色。
寻常温柔套路，困不住心怀山河之人。
想要破局，需投其所好，攻其软肋。”
顾延之转头看向她：“你有法子？”
苏清鸢眸光深远，望向漆黑的夜空，缓缓道：“他无家世倚靠，无朝堂后盾，身陷绝境，步步维艰。

The power and color puzzle (the power and color puzzle) were used to fabricate the crime of liaison with foreign enemies.
Xiao Yan lowered his eyes and looked at the swaying wine in the glass, his eyes cold and calm.
He knew that this glass of wine, which looked like a gentle blessing, was actually very poisonous.
It is not only the drugs that may be hidden in the wine, but also the invisible poison of people's calculations and court intrigues.
He raised his hand, but did not accept the wine. Instead, he raised his hand lightly to support her, and said in a calm but uncomplaining tone: "The princess is a guest from afar, and I treat you as my general.
It's just that the general at the border has always been drunk and has no strength. I hope the princess will forgive me. "
As soon as he finished speaking, he stepped aside, took the tea on the table, took a sip, replaced the wine with tea, and responded calmly.
Completely avoid all gentle traps and don't give the other party any chance to trap you.
The wine glass in Princess Minghua's hand paused slightly, and the gentle smile on her face could hardly be maintained.
She travels in all directions and deals with powerful people. No man has ever been so indifferent and defensive at every step under her beauty offensive.
The Xiao Yan in front of him was terrifyingly calm and surprisingly restrained.
"The general is truly self-disciplined."
Princess Minghua slowly retracted her hand and sighed softly, with a hint of unnoticeable frustration in her tone, "With such a kind heart, no wonder he was able to guard Western Xinjiang for three years, as stable as a rock."
Xiao Yan didn't say anything more, his eyes passed over the lights in the courtyard and looked out into the dark night outside the city.
The fog in Liangzhou City is getting thicker and thicker.
This seemingly prosperous and stable border town has long been saturated with lust for power and lust. Everyone is involved in the situation, and no one can survive alone.
Gentleness is a knife, beauty is a net, and intrigue is a bureau, entangled in layers and airtight.
The banquet didn't break up until late at night.
Xiao Yan said goodbye to everyone, turned around and left, his back tall and lonely, crushing the lights and flowers in the courtyard, leaving no trace of nostalgia.
When he walked away, the warm atmosphere in the courtyard instantly dissipated.
Gu Yanzhi stood on the corridor with a cold face, looking at the direction Xiao Yan was leaving, and said in a deep voice: "If you don't eat oil and salt, and don't eat hard or soft, this Xiao Yan will be a hundred times more difficult to deal with than three years ago."
Princess Minghua walked slowly over, her gentle and charming demeanor faded away, and only cold calculation remained in her eyes: "The deposed prince has been dormant for three years, and his heart is no longer what it used to be.
He seems to be keeping to himself, but in fact he secretly controls the military power in Liangzhou and wins the hearts of the people, and his foundation is increasingly consolidated.
If he cannot be trapped and eliminated as soon as possible, he will become a serious trouble in the future. "
Su Qingyuan stood quietly on the side, the moonlight fell on her elegant profile, the light and dark were intertwined, and her expression was difficult to distinguish.
She spoke softly, her voice was light but precise: "It's not that he is not beautiful, he is not close to useless beauty.
Ordinary gentle tricks cannot trap people who have mountains and rivers in their hearts.
If you want to break the situation, you need to play into their favourites, and attack their weaknesses. "
Gu Yanzhi turned to look at her: "Do you have any idea?"
Su Qingyuan's eyes were far-reaching, looking at the dark night sky, and said slowly: "He has no family to rely on, no court support, and is in a desperate situation, struggling every step of the way.
